summary: Frontend-only test of (1) the new AV Binocular / AV Cerca fields in Evaluación Oftalmológica and (2) the institution badge on Pacientes Presentes cards. Both features pass. Eval 3b315ec0 (IGSS patient 4ceb89de), logged in as superadmin: both fields show up as single boxes under 'Con Corrección' and are editable. Saved 20/30 + J3, re-navigated, reopened from Historial: values were still there. Then restored 20/25 + J2 and checked those persisted too. Tablero del Día, date 2026-10-22: the Carlos Lopez card shows a green (emerald) 'IGSS' badge next to 'Primera Consulta'. Regression flow passed: Iniciar -> 'Atendida' button -> Atendida badge shown, institution badge still there -> menu shows Evaluación Oftalmológica + Deshacer atendida -> Deshacer works. While Presente, the menu shows Cancelar llegada / No asistió. No layout breakage.
critical_code_review_comments: Agenda.js PacientePresenteCard: the Iniciar/Atendida buttons and the 3-dot menu trigger have no data-testid. Consider adding presente-iniciar-{id}, presente-atendida-btn-{id} and presente-menu-{id}.

Mi Agenda ('Mis Pacientes Presentes') uses the same PacientePresenteCard, and /mi-dia includes referral_institution fields (routes/agenda.py ~l.920). medico_test (Dr. Carlos Méndez) has no present patients on 2026-10-22, so the badge was checked in the browser only on the Tablero del Día; for Mi Agenda it was confirmed from the code.
The grey 'Sin institución' / non-IGSS label branch was not seen in the UI because no non-IGSS present patient exists in the test data.
